security_audit.summary: All 66 static findings are false positives caused by documentation terminology and malformed frontmatter. The reviewed files describe CCXT exchange APIs and trading concepts; no executable payload, host reconnaissance, hidden-file access, credential exfiltration, or prompt injection was found. The skill can still guide actions that affect exchange accounts, so users should review generated trading code before running it.

content.value_statement: Exchange APIs differ in authentication, symbols, rate limits, and order behavior. This skill helps you use CCXT documentation to build and troubleshoot consistent integrations.
actual_capabilities: Explains CCXT unified methods for markets, tickers, balances, and orders.
Guides exchange capability checks before using a method.
Explains market-buy cost handling and amount conventions.
Provides reference guidance for rate limiting and asynchronous Python usage.
Helps interpret CCXT order, trade, funding-rate, and exchange error concepts.
limitations: It is documentation guidance and does not execute trades or connect to exchanges.
Exchange support and parameters can change after the included documentation was generated.
It cannot verify account permissions, balances, regional availability, or live market conditions.
Trading code can cause financial loss and requires independent testing and review.

use_cases.title: Create a market data client
use_cases.description: Learn how to load markets and retrieve public market information with CCXT.

use_cases.title: Review order placement logic
use_cases.description: Check amount, cost, and exchange capability considerations before implementing an order flow.

use_cases.title: Troubleshoot an integration
use_cases.description: Use CCXT concepts to investigate errors, rate limits, and exchange-specific behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Learn a CCXT concept
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain how CCXT unified methods work for fetching a ticker. Include the main prerequisites and common mistakes.

prompt_templates.title: Plan market data access
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me plan a CCXT market data integration for one exchange. Cover market loading, rate limits, errors, and testing.

prompt_templates.title: Review order safeguards
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this proposed CCXT order workflow for amount, cost, symbol, capability, and error-handling risks. Do not place an order.

prompt_templates.title: Design an async client
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a Python async CCXT client with bounded concurrency, rate-limit awareness, retries, logging, and a paper-trading test plan.

output_examples.input: How should I prepare before calling a CCXT trading method?
output: Load and validate exchange markets first.
Confirm the exchange supports the intended method.
Use a test environment or paper workflow before real funds.
Log requests safely without exposing credentials.

output_examples.input: Why did a market-buy order use an unexpected amount?
output_examples.output: The response explains that some exchanges require market-buy cost in quote currency. It recommends checking the exchange capability and amount convention before submitting an order.

best_practices: Use read-only market-data calls before testing authenticated operations.
Check exchange capabilities and market metadata before using a method.
Keep API credentials out of prompts, logs, repositories, and error reports.
anti_patterns: Do not submit real orders without validating symbols, amounts, costs, and account permissions.
Do not disable rate limiting to increase request volume.
Do not assume every exchange supports the same order parameters or features.

faq.question: What is CCXT?
faq.answer: CCXT is a library that provides a common interface for many cryptocurrency exchange APIs.

faq.question: Can this skill place trades?
faq.answer: No. It provides documentation guidance and does not execute code or connect to exchanges.

faq.question: Which languages does the reference cover?
faq.answer: The skill includes guidance for JavaScript, Python, and PHP usage patterns.

faq.question: Should I share my API key in a prompt?
faq.answer: No. Keep API keys and secrets private and remove them from code, logs, and support requests.

faq.question: Does every exchange support every CCXT method?
faq.answer: No. Check the exchange capability information and market metadata before relying on a method.

faq.question: Can I use this for live trading?
faq.answer: Use it to understand implementation details, then test independently. Live trading can cause financial loss.
